mapper.select:
select date(oper_time) as day, count(*) as total, count(case when status = 0 then 1 end) as succeeded, count(case when status = 1 then 1 end) as failed from sys_oper_log
group by date(oper_time)

select coalesce(title, '') as title, coalesce(business_type, 0) as businessType, coalesce(status, -1) as status, oper_time as operTime from sys_oper_log
order by oper_time desc, oper_id desc limit 5

select count(*) as total, count(case when visibility = '0' then 1 end) as privateCount, count(case when visibility = '1' then 1 end) as publicCount, count(case when create_time >= #{start} and create_time < #{end} then 1 end) as newCount from sys_memo where owner_user_id = #{userId}
select title, coalesce(update_time, create_time) as updatedAt from sys_memo where owner_user_id = #{userId} order by updatedAt desc, memo_id desc limit 10
